target: acceptance 7 — a clean hardened review is still not a merge signal. Scoped to what THIS spec added: the prior version was satisfied by pre-existing top-of-file boilerplate, and its merge scan used a window narrow enough to miss a merge instruction added elsewhere in the file.
cmd: s="$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/review/SKILL.md"; r="$PLUGIN_ROOT/agents/reviewer.md"; blk=$(awk "/hardened.*additionally runs the/{on=1} on{print} on&&/^   - \\*\\*2\\*\\*/{exit}" "$s" | tr "\n" " " | tr -s " "); says=$(printf "%s" "$blk" | grep -ci "terminates at an open PR"); psays=$(awk "/^## Hardened profile payload/{on=1} on{print}" "$r" | tr "\n" " " | tr -s " " | grep -ci "not a merge signal\|still an open PR"); merge=$(grep -c "gh pr merge\|git merge" "$s" "$r" | awk -F: "{t+=\$2} END{print t+0}"); printf '{"routeSaysPR":%s,"payloadSaysPR":%s,"mergeCmds":%s}' "$says" "$psays" "$merge"
